narrative.details:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for returning these stolen books, Jødekong. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

mentionedItems.name: Sack of "Picture" Books
tooltip: "Every book in this sack is a children's picture book. Kobolds clearly can't read, but why do they want these books?"

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 2 to 7, 2,630 XP in all.

quests.name: Nibbled-On Book
quests.objectiveText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Rascally Rodents
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Mining Consultant
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

quests.name: The Big Picture
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf.

quests.name: Follow That Kobold!
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
quests.objectiveText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

quests.name: Book Return
quests.objectiveText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

quests.name: Rare Books
quests.objectiveText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
